title: Postage or revenue stamps, stamp-postmarks, first-day covers, postal stationery (stamped paper) and the like

review.classification: UNSD CPC 3.0 notes p. 197 explicitly list first-day covers at 38962. At p. 152, 32610 covers unused stamps and stamp-impressed paper. The prior unused stamp printing draft does not establish the requested association. The new material method retains the original semantic PCR identity and qualifies the finished cancelled physical collectible.
review.product_evidence: USPS product 894516 is a completed paper envelope bearing a genuine stamp and official postmark. The stamp has lost postal validity on that object. Canada Post provides first-party evidence both for finished covers and for customer-submitted cancellation and actual mailing services. The two operators supply distinct evidence. Neither supplies a common measured facility inventory, cover weight or emissions factor.
review.technical_repair: The initial draft had an unclosed case for all-failed batches and did not connect the included inbound freight calculation to an inventory row. The author added explicit Q=0 retention without a unit result, WIP burden vectors, matched transfers and unique first release, plus conditional freight and outsourced cancellation rows with primary collection and included-scope rules. The repaired English and Chinese sections retain unbundled, measured carrier activity once and prevent overlapping provider, ink, electricity and postal-service burdens.
review.readiness: The bilingual candidate contains 11 corresponding exchanges. All 11 native exchange identities remain unresolved. The product has a verified mass-to-kg measurement basis. The independent scoped check completed 58 measurements with zero skips and eight advisory warnings. Actual issue, batch, supplier, ink, lot and transport evidence remain foreground requirements.
